title: Going To: Planned Future
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora dominas 'going to' para hablar de planes e intenciones futuras ya decididas, una estructura clave en el inglés corporativo.

parts.visual: Estructura: Sujeto + am/is/are + going to + Verbo. I am going to present the results (Voy a presentar los resultados). She is going to call the client (Ella va a llamar al cliente).
parts.audio: Structure: Subject plus am, is, or are plus going to plus verb. I am going to present the results. She is going to call the client.

parts.visual: Usos: Planes ya decididos e intenciones. Negativo: not going to. Pregunta: Are you going to...? Diferencia con will: going to = plan previo; will = decisión espontánea.
parts.audio: Uses: Already decided plans and intentions. Negative: not going to. Question: Are you going to? Difference with will: going to is a previous plan, will is a spontaneous decision.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta con 'going to'.

questions.question: I am going to ____ the report. (Presentar).
She ____ going to call the client.
We ____ going to launch a new product.
I am ____ going to miss the deadline.
____ you going to attend the conference? (Pregunta).

No, she ____. (Respuesta corta negativa).
They are going to ____ the contract next week. (Firmar).
He is going to ____ the meeting. (Dirigir).
We are going to ____ a new office. (Abrir).
I am going to ____ the proposal. (Revisar).
She is not going to ____ the budget. (Aprobar).
What are you going to ____? (Hacer).
